red_tests.failure_fingerprint: Reintroducing any R2 bucket binding into wrangler.toml while R2 is disabled on the Cloudflare account (API error 10042) fails these guards and re-breaks every wrangler deploy (PR #135 dispatch regression class).

rationale: KAN-264 close-out: dispatching workers-builds.yml (production) after PR #135's token fix exposed the true deploy blocker - R2 is not enabled on the Cloudflare account (error 10042), and wrangler.toml declared an unused ARTIFACTS R2 binding (api/index.js never references it; _worker.js guards with if(env.ARTIFACTS)). This baseline removes the binding and inverts the stale binding-must-exist tests into absence guards. Red verified against binding-present config: 3 failed; green after removal: 15 passed; wrangler deploy --dry-run clean.
